rule: rows in [boundary, boundary+gap) are removed by the purge; count in data_quality_report.json
stage2_rule: a forecast window is train only if its last TARGET hour is before train_end; val/test only if its FIRST INPUT hour is on/after val_start/test_start (common/dataio/windows.py). Long-context summaries may look further back: that is history a forecaster would really have, never a training target.
